messages:
Sara K: Quick sync — need alignment on the chat completions payload shape before next sprint. Customers (PilotCorp + Zendesk POC) are pushing for both a `messages` array and a legacy `prompt` string. Can we pick a launch strategy?

Miguel: I vote canonical `messages` array. Keep items tiny: `{role, content, name?}`. Easier to reason about roles and batching.

Alex P: Agree on canonical messages. We must add a compatibility layer that maps `prompt`→`messages` for SDKs and server-side so customers don't break. Also flag implications for streaming & function calling.

Kei: Proposal: API accepts both (`messages` and `prompt`). Immediately normalize to `messages` internally. Explicit roles: `system`, `user`, `assistant`. If `prompt` is provided, map it to a `user` message unless `system_prompt` param present. Example normalization: 

```json
{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"<prompt>"}]}
```

Sara K: Launch criteria we care about: function/tool-calling support, streaming token-level responses, SDK helpers for migration, docs + examples, and no regressions on our eval promptsets. Also need canary plan.

Alex P: For function calling we should include `name` on assistant messages when the assistant chooses a function and an `arguments` blob for structured payloads. Reserve a `platform_meta` field for routing/telemetry only.

Miguel: Performance note — lots of short system messages increases token overhead. Consider a top-level `system_prompt` alias that compiles into the first system message but helps batching heuristics and reduces repetitive tokenization on server side.

Kei: Migration plan (proposal):
1) Accept both `prompt` and `messages` at launch; if both exist, `messages` wins.
2) SDKs auto-convert `prompt` to `messages` and emit a deprecation warning.
3) After 3 months, server-side `prompt` becomes deprecated; legacy mode opt-in for 6 months for enterprise customers.

Sara K: Operational rollout checklist: 
- Docs + quickstart & SDK shims ✅
- Canary at 10% traffic for 2 weeks with quality/regression gates ✅
- Streaming + function calling smoke tests ✅
- Tokenization/cost baseline metrics collected ✅
- Legal & security sign-off ✅

ProductBot: RFC created — https://redwood.internal/docs/rfcs/chat-payload-v2 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Draft schema posted to /internal/schemas/chat_v2.json

Sara K: Ok. Next actions: publish draft to eng for review today. @Alex P @Miguel can you own the canary plan and define the metric set? :thumbsup:
